query: 产品安全政策 产品安全政策 衡量企业在产品设计、原材料采购、生产测试、上市后监测及召回等全生命周期中的安全管理机制。重点考察预防性设计、质量监测频率及产品安全责任的归属与闭环机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备“本质安全”设计准则；执行严于行业标准的内部测试；建立了主动的上市后安全监测（PMS）系统；具备明确的缺陷产品召回规程及高层负责的责任机制。 • 1分（合格）：建立了基础的质量管理体系（如 ISO 9001），具备标准化的出厂检测流程和被动的客户投诉处理机制，但缺乏全生命周期的预防性监控或明确的召回演练。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式产品安全政策披露，或仅有笼统的“质量至上”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：安全管理机制覆盖 >80% 的产品线、在售品项或业务收入，核心实体通过了行业特定的质量认证（如 IATF 16949, ISO 13485）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心产品具备完整策略，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 产品安全政策 产品质量管理 本质安全设计 产品测试 上市后监测 缺陷管理 质量认证 产品安全责任 ISO 9001 PMS ISO 13485 product safety policy product quality management design for safety product testing post-market surveillance PMS defect management ISO 9001 product liability ISO 13485 是否有覆盖产品设计、原材料采购、生产测试、上市后监测及召回的产品安全或质量管理政策？ 是否披露本质安全设计、FMEA等风险分析或内部测试？ 是否有标准化出厂检测和客户投诉处理？ 是否建立上市后安全监测、批次追溯及缺陷召回责任机制？ 机制覆盖多少产品线、在售品项或业务收入？ 核心实体取得哪些质量认证？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '产品安全政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有覆盖产品设计、原材料采购、生产测试、上市后监测及召回的产品安全或质量管理政策？ 是否披露本质安全设计、FMEA等风险分析或内部测试？ 是否有标准化出厂检测和客户投诉处理？ 是否建立上市后安全监测、批次追溯及缺陷召回责任机制？ 机制覆盖多少产品线、在售品项或业务收入？ 核心实体取得哪些质量认证？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“质量至上”口号；仅有召回率数字而无制度；仅有负责任营销准则；仅有客户满意度调查；区分：产品安全政策关注全生命周期安全管理机制；召回程序关注召回制度与通知追踪；产品回收率是召回数量占比统计，不是政策本身。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

The Committee is responsible for the assessment and communication of product safety risks related to the Group, or the formulation or implementation of risk control measures for product risks. [Content]
Sihuan Pharmaceutical has established the Drug Safety Committee which comprises senior management of the Group and heads of commercial, marketing, production and quality departments. The Committee is responsible for the assessment and communication of product safety risks related to the Group, or the formulation or implementation of risk control measures for product risks. If the PV Department detects a suspected product safety risk, it will convene the meeting in time and take risk control measures, including but not limited to the recall of the involved product, according to the assessment results of the meeting. During the Year, no major safety risk signals of products were recorded and no large-scale drug recalls occurred.

The Group integrates the concept of sustainable development into the entire process of supply chain and pays continuous attention to the environmental and social risks of suppliers. results.section: 責任並進，互利共贏 / Making Progress Together with Responsibility to Promote Win-win Cooperation
results.text: We actively conduct supplier sourcing and review the qualifications such as business licenses of comparable suppliers and evaluate their production capabilities, technological levels, service quality and other aspects to ensure that their qualifications and quality meet the Group's engagement requirements. In the supplier admission process, we detect samples provided by comparable suppliers, and for material suppliers who have a significant impact on drug quality, sample detection, supplier audit and small batch tests are required. Suppliers who passed the admission reviews will be included in the Group's qualified supplier list. For qualified suppliers, the Group conducts continuous evaluation through daily supervision and management and annual assessment based on indicators such as quality status, cooperativeness and performance of suppliers, and urges them to improve the quality of their products and services. We conduct the hierarchical management of suppliers. Based on the assessment and examination results, we classify the suppliers into different grades and implement distinct reward and punishment policies. Suppliers who breach the contracts, violate the bidding requirements, provide products or services with quality problems, or are rated as poor in assessment will be required to suspend the transactions, take rectification action within a definite period or will be blacklisted directly, according to the severity or the degree of harm.

Based on the assessment and examination results, we classify the suppliers into different grades and implement distinct reward and punishment policies. Suppliers who breach the contracts, violate the bidding requirements, provide products or services with quality problems, or are rated as poor in assessment will be required to suspend the transactions, take rectification action within a definite period or will be blacklisted directly, according to the severity or the degree of harm.
